decision_question: Does the exact pinned property-based-testing skill discover and prevent seeded edge-case defects missed by the same stack without it?

primary_estimand.name: seeded edge-case defect detection rate
primary_estimand.description: Matched-condition difference in seeded edge-case defect detection rate; critical failures, invalid runs, cost, and latency remain separate gates.
primary_estimand.aggregation: Report task and stratum outcomes before a prespecified paired aggregate; numeric threshold and uncertainty method remain calibration-blocked.

conditions.label: Frozen strong Codex baseline
conditions.delta_from_baseline: Reference condition; exact runtime and context snapshot remain to be frozen after activation calibration.

conditions.label: trailofbits-property-based-testing
conditions.delta_from_baseline: Adds the exact source-locked upstream skill tree to the otherwise frozen base condition.

contamination_notes: Public mechanics task only; cannot enter a skill-effect estimate or hidden confirmation pack.
Must not prescribe the target behavior or reuse public calibration defects.
No candidate author, adaptation run, or screening evaluator may access this pack before finalist freeze.

budget.description: Match total-system resources after activation calibration; no numeric execution cap is yet frozen.

dimensions.rule: count every parent, subagent, integration, and retry call
record actual elapsed time and predeclare timeout

adaptation_boundary.description: Every compatibility adaptation is a separately named content-addressed intervention. Screening selects one frozen finalist or rejects all; holdout failure cannot promote a runner-up.

selection_rules: Require source-lock verification and observed intervention activation before effectiveness screening.
Select or reject using only frozen screening rules; do not revise a candidate after seeing holdout evidence.
Keep invalid, negative, and inconclusive cells in the evidence package.
stop_rules: Run third-party content only as an exact source-locked, maintainer-reviewed snapshot in maintainer-controlled execution; arbitrary submissions remain blocked.
Stop if task instructions prescribe the target behavior, evaluators cannot distinguish pristine inputs, or condition equality is not evidenced.
Retry only operationally invalid byte-equivalent runs under a predeclared rule.
Do not publish an effectiveness or leaderboard claim from the public calibration task.

independence_claim.label: maintainer_evaluated
role_overlaps: Kizz owns the experiment contract, task-pack process, execution, and final decision; external independent replication is not yet assigned.
